profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a Software engineer with experience in multiple technologies, like blockchain, RoR, React and more. I have worked on products that have been used by some of the biggest Chilean companies, like Cencosud, Falabella, and Entel.

I participated in "ndorse.me", an influencer marketing platform winner of Startup Chile 2016, and BadgeHeroes, a gamification platform winner of Imagine Labs 2018 which is used in employee training and e-learning.

I have worked in many projects, participating in all the necessary steps for product development, including raising requirements, backend and frontend development, software architecture, deployment, and client support.

I am good at understanding other people's problems, and I like to help them always as possible. I am proactive, independent and adaptable to any environment. I enjoy learning new things, taking new challenges and I'm not afraid to work on something unknown.

positions.title: Advisory Software Engineer
positions.description: Technical advisoring and management of development teams

positions.title: Co Founder
positions.description: Historia Clínica is a patient management software for health professionals. I am in charge of customer supporting and code development.

positions.title: Co-Founder / CTO
positions.description:
Software consulting company, dedicated to design and develop solutions in multiple situations.
In Quantic, i had the opportunity to work in all the steps in the product development process, including the problem identification, raise requirements and the final solution construction. 

Some projects in which i worked:

Blockchain
Bitvana, LatamCoinCap, Trading bot, QWallet
QWallet was the first cryptocurrency wallet in Latin America. It has been used by thousands of users.

AI
Easyfit, Airscrape, Trading bot, Classybot
Classybot is a classification tool for feedback from clients of some of the biggest Chilean companies, like Cencosud and Falabella.

Health
HistoriaClínica, EasyFit, Denticlick
Denticlick is a patient management software for dentists, which is currently used by the Manquehue Clinic.

Marketing
Inacap Survey, Historia Clínica
Digital Marketing campaign for Historia Clínica software with Google and Facebook Ads

Process Automatization 
SinPlagas, Classybot, Airscrape
Airscrape is a software whose track the airplane flights made within Chilean territory. The software get and process relevant information for decision making.

Others
SoSafe, panic button used by several locations in Santiago, Chile

positions.title: Main Software Architect / Developer
positions.description:
Platform which applies gamification concepts for capacitations, e-learning and employee trainings programs. 

Definition of the scope of the project in each stage
Raise new requirements based on users feedback
Design the software architecture and its components interaction. 
Design of each component
Develop and deploy of each app (Web, Android, iOS)

Badgeheroes also was one of the winners of Imagine Labs 2018, and has been used by big companies, like Copec, Scotiabank and Entel.

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.locationName: Provincia de Santiago, Santiago Metropolitan Region, Chile
positions.description:
Software de influencer marketing, cuyo objetivo es brindar una herramienta a personas comunes para que puedan promocionar los productos que más les gusten.

Diseño y desarrollo de aplicación web
Módulo de tracking, integrado con google analytics
Integración con principales plataformas de e-commerce, como Magento y Prestashop
Manuales de Integración para cada plataforma
Asistencia a clientes

Proyecto ganador de Startup Chile 2016

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Trademedia es una empresa de cartelería digital que administra múltiples monitores a través de una aplicación central en la nube.

Optimización de aplicaciones de administración y reproductora de contenido.
Standarización de comunicación entre plataforma de administración y reproducción
Creación de sitio web autogestionable estilo youtube interno para empresas (CorpTube)

positions.title: Co-fundador / Software Developer
positions.description:
Empresa consultora de software.
Algunos proyectos en los que trabajé:

Infotab
Publicidad personalizada por medio de tablets, dirigidas a pasajeros que utilizan
transfers desde/hacia el aeropuerto. Definición de producto, arquitectura e implementación

TagPass
Sistema de monitoreo de pago de tags en autopistas. Diseño de software web y mobile e implementación.

StreetChat
Chat masivo basado en geolocalización. Conceptualización de producto y desarrollo de app mobile.

NeoParking
Software de gestión de estacionamientos. Definición de producto, implementación y testing en terreno.
